expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Records a transaction snapshot for editor undo/redo. @param bAlwaysMarkDirty Marks the package dirty even when no transaction is active. Marks the containing package dirty and returns whether the state changed. Returns whether the object class implements InterfaceClass. Reloads config-backed properties from configuration files. Copies compatible script properties from OtherObject. Exposes the canonical null UObject handle constant. Creates an object typed to Class within Outer. @param bTransient Applies transient lifetime/persistence semantics when true. Creates or resolves the internal asset object used by an asset literal. Completes internal asset-literal setup after object creation.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: bool UObject.Modify(bool bAlwaysMarkDirty = true); | bool UObject.MarkPackageDirty() const; | bool UObject.ImplementsInterface(const UClass InterfaceClass) const; | void UObject.ReloadConfig(); | void UObject.CopyScriptPropertiesFrom(const UObject OtherObject); | const UObject null; | UObject NewObject(UObject Outer, const TSubclassOf<UObject>& Class, FName Name = NAME_None, bool bTransient = false); | UObject __CreateLiteralAsset(UClass AssetClass, const FString& Name); | void __PostLiteralAssetSetup(UObject Asset, const FString& Name);
